Acknowledged coverage debt, not a target and not a place to add entries.

module-consumer-coverage derives this set statically: every test file reachable from a module
owner/interface path must be declared as owner, contract or consumer evidence for that module.
1709 such declarations never existed. Requiring all of them at once would leave the guard red for
weeks, so the current set is pinned here and the guard fails only on entries that are NOT in it.
Paying it down is #218 (classify, then fill, narrow or retire per entry).

One-time snapshot. Entries may only be DELETED by hand as the debt is paid; the guard prints how
many were paid. Do not regenerate this file - a regenerated baseline silently accepts new debt,
which is exactly what the guard exists to prevent.
